method: Current WPF controls rendered with isolated sample databases; no production data. sticky-live includes a real offscreen WebView2 editor. Browser gallery displays these captures, it is not the native app.
limitations: Preview harness omits FocusStore and therefore hides FocusTab in main-window images. The standalone focus capture uses the actual FocusPage.
Native layout images do not establish accessibility, interactive latency, multiple-monitor placement or high-DPI correctness.
sticky-live uses a generated test background, contains test typing and captures a transient saving label.
Preview harness examples vary between captures; counts are illustrative, not production user data.
